title: Confirm cash-on-delivery orders by phone
persona: Loses money on fake cash-on-delivery orders and has two people calling customers before dispatch. Talks in quick Hinglish, answers one question at a time, and wants the callers to see only who is left to call.
opening: COD orders confirm karne ka process chahiye, call karke confirm ya cancel

facts.cancel in Shopify too: nahi, abhi sirf app me mark karna hai, Shopify me main khud cancel karta hoon

success: there is a status with To call, Confirmed and Cancelled
a new cash-on-delivery order starts at To call
a filter, tab or view shows only the orders still to call
the plan is said in plain words before anything is built, with no field names or types
ends by asking whether to build
must_not: cancelling an order in Shopify without the owner's yes
a rule that writes a status into every row on a schedule
